primary_sources.title: Time-of-day periodicities of trading volume and volatility in Bitcoin exchange: Does the stock market matter?
primary_sources.claim: Bitcoin volume and volatility exhibit intraday periodicity and are elevated during European and US market hours.
primary_sources.limitations: Bitstamp 2015-2018; periodic activity is not direct evidence of profitable continuation after current BingX costs.

primary_sources.title: The intraday dynamics of Bitcoin
primary_sources.claim: Volume, volatility and liquidity vary by time of day, with elevated realized volatility near major global market openings.
primary_sources.limitations: Historical spot-exchange evidence; exchange, regime and cost transfer must be falsified on the immutable corpus.

primary_sources.title: Bitcoin Time-of-Day, Day-of-Week and Month-of-Year Effects in Returns and Trading Volume
primary_sources.claim: Time-specific Bitcoin effects are time-varying and not consistently persistent across the sample.
primary_sources.limitations: Negative control against assuming stable session alpha; requires rolling and holdout stability.

primary_sources.title: Periodicity in Cryptocurrency Volatility and Liquidity
primary_sources.claim: Systematic hour-of-day and within-hour patterns occur in Bitcoin and Ether volatility and volume, with links to algorithmic activity and futures funding times.
primary_sources.limitations: Preprint evidence; periodicity alone does not establish directional continuation.

video_sources.title: Volume profile and Bitcoin trading context
video_sources.claim_to_test: Session-local volume distribution may distinguish continuation from generic breakouts.
video_sources.limitations: Popularity and discretionary chart interpretation are not economic evidence.

video_sources.title: Institutional volume analysis for crypto markets
video_sources.claim_to_test: Abnormal participation around market transitions may carry more information than raw clock time.
video_sources.limitations: No claim may be used without a closed-bar deterministic definition.

video_sources.title: Crypto volume profile methodology
video_sources.claim_to_test: Volume concentration and expansion may condition event continuation.
video_sources.limitations: Platform indicators and visual examples must not become hidden replay logic.

video_sources.title: Best Crypto Volatility Indicator
video_sources.claim_to_test: ATR or realized-volatility conditioning may improve breakout/event selectivity.
video_sources.limitations: Marketing, parameter search and unpublished test details create high overfit risk.
